title: Dense-open constructibility of affine-line compact support over a finite-type integer base
statement: Let Λ be a finite commutative ring, Y an affine scheme with coordinate ring finite type over the integers, F a constructible étale Λ-module sheaf on A¹_Y, c any compactification of its projection [def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification], and q an integer. There exists a dense open V of Y such that the restriction to V of H^q(Ra_!^c(F[0])) is constructible [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf].

proof.text: Choose a dense open affine spectrum over which the input is lisse on an open with finite closed complement. Pullback of the input remains constructible.

Choose compactifications for the open and closed pieces. The lisse-open-relative-line input gives constructible cohomology for the open piece. The finite closed piece is quasi-finite and finitely presented over the Noetherian base; apply quasi-finite shriek constructibility to the pullback of F[0].

Use the compact-support open-closed triangle. Transport the two outer vertices by the exact inverse-image single-functor isomorphism. Constructible homology is triangulated, so the middle vertex has constructible homology in every degree. This is the Serre five-term argument packaged in the existing triangulated object-property API.

Exact inverse image, the existing compact-support exchange isomorphism, and compactification independence identify this cohomology with the pullback of the original cohomology. Identify the open immersion with its open range and pull back along its inverse isomorphism to conclude.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_dense_open_affineLine_shriek_constructible
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ] (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Y]
    [Algebra.FiniteType ℤ Γ(Y, ⊤)]
    (F : Sheaf (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) Y).smallEtaleTopology
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (hF : Scheme.IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf F)
    (c : Compactification (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) Y ↘ Y)) (q : ℤ) :
    ∃ U : Y.Opens, Dense (U : Set Y) ∧
      Scheme.IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf
        ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U.ι).obj
          ((_root_.DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor
        (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) q).obj
        ((Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlus (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) c).obj
          ((_root_.DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor
            (Sheaf (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) Y).smallEtaleTopology
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) 0).obj F))))

mathlib_searches.query: A dense open of a relative affine line has finite complement after shrinking to a dense affine open of the Noetherian affine base
mathlib_searches.results: Returned signatures concern basicOpen constructibility, affine Zariski cover density and equality of restricted sections. No compact-support or shrinking match.

Read Mathlib prime avoidance and minimal-prime topology, and source AffineSpace.Fiber, ConstructibleSheaf.GenericConstancy and Mathlib.Topology.KrullDimension. Reused the dimension-one finite-boundary theorem and generic constancy; no duplicate of these three new statements.
